summary: Handoff for the build.sh uv compatibility hotfix. The launcher now keeps uv sync as the preferred path but falls back to .venv/pip editable install when uv sync is unsupported or unusable, so the web UI startup path is no longer blocked by older uv versions.
delivered: build.sh probes uv sync support before using it.
build.sh falls back when uv sync fails at runtime, including the local sandboxed uv-cache failure class.
build.sh bootstraps pip into .venv when a uv-created environment lacks pip.
build.sh uses --no-build-isolation for pip fallback when setuptools and wheel are already present, avoiding unnecessary network-only build dependency resolution in prepared workspaces.
README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md document uv-or-pip fallback behavior.
Verification, security, release, and handoff AppForge artifacts were refreshed after the hotfix.
Source archive created at .appforge/reports/AppForge-LLM-v4-source.zip with 267 files and 459539 bytes before final handoff completion.
quickstart: Run ./build.sh from the repository root to prepare dependencies, build packaged web assets, start appforge web, and open the browser.
Run APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check to verify a prepared workspace without starting the server.
Run APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8799 ./build.sh --smoke to start the web server without opening a browser, probe /api/health and /, then stop it.
If the installed uv lacks sync, the launcher prints that it is falling back and continues with pip editable install.
If uv sync exists but fails locally, the launcher attempts the same pip fallback before failing.
architecture_reference: .appforge/artifacts/workflow_spec.json: WF-002 covers uv or venv/pip fallback creating an executable .venv/bin/appforge.
.appforge/artifacts/memory_spec.json: MEM-002 covers .venv dependency readiness and invalidation.
build.sh: install_python_with_pip, uv_supports_sync, and ensure_python_env implement the hotfix.
verification_reference: APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check passed after uv sync failed locally and pip fallback completed.

Simulated old uv without sync support passed through pip fallback: bash -c 'uv() { printf "error: unrecognized subcommand '\''sync'\''\n" >&2; return 2; }; export -f uv; APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check'.
APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8799 ./build.sh --smoke passed and stopped its web server pid.
AppForge run_tests, run_build, secret_scan, release_readiness, and archive_workspace gates passed.
Archive assertion verified build.sh fallback content is included and .appforge, .appforge-web, dist, .git, node_modules, and .venv are excluded.
operations_reference: APPFORGE_WEB_HOST and APPFORGE_WEB_PORT override the bind endpoint.
APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 skips frontend build and requires packaged web assets to exist.
APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1 requests optional bridge startup; APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE=1 disables launcher-owned bridge startup.
No deployment, publishing, push, or external provider call was performed.
